about: Ablation sets for the combined proof (scripts/proof.ts): each stage's mechanisms switched off with everything else on, run against an all-on baseline at the same settings. A stage owner declares its set; null means not declared yet, and the full proof refuses to start until every set is declared. Values are registry overrides (createWorld params).

C7a.note: The C6b values of the C7a knobs (artifacts/validation/c7a/pipeline.log); C7c's joint trips build on C7a's committed trips, so this ablation also weakens C7c.

C7c.note: Joint trips and waiting off; the energetic distance scale (62,900 m) back to the C7a fit (60,000 m). Depletable fallback foods are already off by default (fallbackCapH 0). Confirmed by the C7c owner: with this set the C7c merge (762a259) gives field worlds hash-identical to main before it (cacf3e7), seeds 48 and 3303 after 5 days.

C7e.note: C7d route chaining and the C7e goal-distance scale. The C7d direction check and the C7e fit (against Taï) dropped both, so both are 0 by default and this set equals the defaults. Checked: the C7d/C7e branch with this set is hash-identical to main 342baa9 (seeds 48 and 3303, 5 days). The C7b switches (followCommit, tripRateValue, cropFullExp) and the C7c fallback limits (fallbackCapH) are also 0 by default.

C8.note: To be declared by the C8 owner at merge (the guardian levers A1 and A2 of docs/staging/early-life-prereg.md).

C10.note: All C10 switches; off reproduces the pre-C10 world exactly (tests/sim-signals.test.ts).

patrols.note: All C6 patrol corrections off: the C6 community danger grid instead of per-chimp contact memory (P2), the C6 cluster instead of single file and calls allowed (P4a), the energy gate back (A2), the heard-strangers boost (P1), staleness-only routes (A1), the 2.5 h cap (A3), the alpha lead bonus (A4), uniform pace and no release (P4a). Female participation settings (P3) keep their values, which are today's literals.

C13a.note: The rules decision policy (intention gate and sampling) off: the argmax rules (tests/sim-rg.test.ts).

C13b.note: Food valued by intake rate off: feeding and trip worth as before C13 (with rgOn 0 as well, hash-identical to the model before C13).
